abstract: Autopsy findings in 20 cases of clinical extragonadal germ-cell tumors arising in the anterior mediastinum are presented. The histologic types were: 2 choriocarcinomas, 3 seminomas, 3 malignant teratomas, 3 embryonal carcinomas, and 9 mixed germ-cell tumors. All of the patients were men, and the ages ranged from 14 to 45 years, with a mean of 32.5 years. The mean survival for these patients after diagnosis was 10.9 months. Local recurrence was characteristic of non-seminomatous tumors. In patients with seminoma, local control of the disease was good, but distant metastases were the cause of death. The most frequent sites of metastases were lungs, bones and liver. In all 20 cases, the testes were carefully step-sectioned. Occult tumor was found in only one case of embryonal carcinoma and a well-defined testicular scar with calcification in a patient with choriocarcinoma. Both patients had lower retroperitoneal metastases. These findings support the premise that, in the majority of cases, these tumors had a primary extragonadal origin.
abstract_ja: 前縦隔に生じた臨床的な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の男性20例の剖検所見を示す。組織型は絨毛癌2例、セミノーマ3例、悪性奇形腫3例、胎児性癌3例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍9例であった。全例男性で、年齢は14〜45歳、平均32.5歳であった。診断後の平均生存期間は10.9か月であった。非セミノーマ性腫瘍では局所再発が特徴的であった。セミノーマ例では局所制御は良好であったが、死因は遠隔転移であった。転移の好発部位は肺、骨、肝であった。全20例で精巣を段階的に切片作製して慎重に検索した。潜在性腫瘍が認められたのは胎児性癌の1例のみで、絨毛癌の1例では石灰化を伴う明瞭な精巣瘢痕を認めた。両者とも後腹膜の下部転移を有していた。これらの所見は、ほとんどの症例で腫瘍が原発性の性腺外起源であったという考えを支持する。
